## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run check:licenses` and `npm run check:library` pass
- [ ] New user-facing text goes through `t()` and has an Italian entry
- [ ] Geometry or file-format changes have a test; a bug fix has a test
- [ ] Table values from a standard cite the standard and clause; unverified values went to `docs/to-verify.md`
- [ ] A line under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
